title: Republic Day parade illustration at India Gate
subject: History
caption: Republic Day parade at India Gate with the President giving the salute.
altText: A photorealistic textbook illustration showing the Republic Day parade at India Gate on a white background. The central monument, India Gate, is labelled and flanked by rows of marching soldiers from the Army, Navy, and Air Force, each wearing distinct uniforms. Colorful Indian flags line the route, and a marching band with brass instruments is depicted. At the front, a raised dais holds the President of India, clearly labelled, raising a hand in salute. Ceremonial vehicles and a crowd of spectators are also labelled, providing a comprehensive view of the ceremony.
